## 1h
```{r}

# Fix zeros
CNLSY79$ste_ppvt_totstd5[CNLSY79$ste_ppvt_totstd5 <= 0] <- 1e-6

# Remove NA incomes
CNLSY79 <- CNLSY79[!is.na(CNLSY79$ste_ppvt_totstd5), ]

# Convert NA groups
CNLSY79$mothers_schooling_level <- ifelse(is.na(CNLSY79$mothers_schooling_level), "Unknown", CNLSY79$mothers_schooling_level)

# Overall mean
mu_total <- mean(CNLSY79$ste_ppvt_totstd5)

# Group means
mu_group <- tapply(CNLSY79$ste_ppvt_totstd5, CNLSY79$mothers_schooling_level, mean)

# Income shares s_k
s_group <- tapply(CNLSY79$ste_ppvt_totstd5, CNLSY79$mothers_schooling_level, sum) / sum(CNLSY79$ste_ppvt_totstd5)

# Theil T within each group
T_group <- tapply(CNLSY79$ste_ppvt_totstd5, CNLSY79$mothers_schooling_level, function(x) entropy(x))

# Within-group component
within <- sum(s_group * T_group)

# Between-group component
between <- sum(s_group * log(mu_group / mu_total))

# Total from decomposition
total_decomp <- within + between

# Total computed directly
total_direct <- entropy(CNLSY79$ste_ppvt_totstd5)

list(
  total_direct   = total_direct,
  total_decomp   = total_decomp,
  within         = within,
  between        = between,
  share_within   = within / total_decomp,
  share_between  = between / total_decomp
)




```

## 2j
```{r}

# Fix zeros
Ghana$wage[Ghana$wage <= 0] <- 1e-6

# Remove NA incomes
Ghana <- Ghana[!is.na(Ghana$wage), ]

# Convert NA groups
Ghana$highest_schooling_level <- ifelse(is.na(Ghana$highest_schooling_level), "Unknown", Ghana$highest_schooling_level)

# Overall mean
mu_total <- mean(Ghana$wage)

# Group means
mu_group <- tapply(Ghana$wage, Ghana$highest_schooling_level, mean)

# Income shares s_k
s_group <- tapply(Ghana$wage, Ghana$highest_schooling_level, sum) / sum(Ghana$wage)

# Theil T within each group
T_group <- tapply(Ghana$wage, Ghana$highest_schooling_level, function(x) entropy(x))

# Within-group component
within <- sum(s_group * T_group)

# Between-group component
between <- sum(s_group * log(mu_group / mu_total))

# Total from decomposition
total_decomp <- within + between

# Total computed directly
total_direct <- entropy(Ghana$wage)

list(
  total_direct   = total_direct,
  total_decomp   = total_decomp,
  within         = within,
  between        = between,
  share_within   = within / total_decomp,
  share_between  = between / total_decomp
)



```
